galleries.title: Battle for the Bay 2
galleries.dek: Tampa Knights came to our patio for round two of the Battle for the Bay series, and Kava Social took the win. Kudos to Tampa: a hard-fought night, and their strongest players ran the top section.
galleries.dek_es: Los Tampa Knights vinieron a nuestro patio para la segunda ronda de la serie Battle for the Bay, y Kava Social se llevó la victoria. Mérito para Tampa: una noche muy peleada, y sus jugadores más fuertes dominaron la sección más alta.

email.subject: 📸 Battle for the Bay 2: the photos are in
email.preheader: 69 photos by Ava Grace from the night Kava took the win.
email.title: Battle for the Bay 2: the photos are in
email.intro: Sunday 15 November, Tampa Knights came to our patio for round two of the Battle for the Bay series, and Kava Social took the win. Ava Grace was there all night with her camera, and the gallery is up now: every board, every handshake, every trophy.
body: Kudos to Tampa: it was a hard-fought night, and their strongest players ran the top section. Thank you for making the drive. Round three is coming.
Thank you to Ava Grace for photographing the night. If you like her work, her site is photosbyavagrace.mypixieset.com.
